decisions.reason: Garage door operators are a core complementary product, and having a dedicated page signals strategic importance, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
A solid wood sectional door is a niche variant with lower volume and is only mentioned on the website, but large door makers typically keep such lines to round out the range.
Operators with remote control are standard demand in the residential market, so the product would likely remain, perhaps later updated rather than dropped.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are a staple of the industrial portfolio and have long lifecycles, so dropping one after a year is unlikely.
Insulated glazed industrial doors meet growing energy-efficiency requirements, which supports keeping the product.
Its own dedicated page indicates a featured industrial door product that the firm is actively promoting.
